evidence.claim: The President may not declare a state of war without a resolution of both Houses sitting in joint session, and combat duty outside Nigeria requires prior Senate approval.
evidence.title: Nigeria 1999 (rev. 2023) Constitution
evidence.excerpt: The President may not declare a state of war without a resolution of both Houses sitting in joint session, and combat duty outside Nigeria requires prior Senate approval.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary constitutional text; the restriction is explicit and directly relevant.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This constrained Buhari’s office in 2022 regardless of personal preference.
contrary_evidence: It does not prove what he actually chose in any crisis.

evidence.claim: Each State Party undertakes not to carry out, encourage, or participate in any nuclear weapon test explosion or other nuclear explosion.
evidence.title: Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty text
evidence.excerpt: Each State Party undertakes not to carry out, encourage, or participate in any nuclear weapon test explosion or other nuclear explosion.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary treaty text from the treaty organization itself.
evidence.period_fit: Treaty norm in force for Nigeria’s 2022 policy environment
evidence.ruler_attribution: This is a binding norm on Nigeria as a state party, not an individual presidential act.
contrary_evidence: A treaty obligation does not prove perfect observance in every year.

evidence.claim: Nigeria is listed as a party that ratified the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, with ratification dated 6 August 2020.
evidence.title: Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons
evidence.excerpt: Nigeria is listed as a party that ratified the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons, with ratification dated 6 August 2020.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: UN Treaty Collection is the authoritative source for participant status and dates.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Not Buhari’s personal act in 2022, but it defined the anti-nuclear treaty posture he governed.
contrary_evidence: Ratification is strong posture evidence, but not proof of later implementation on its own.

evidence.claim: Buhari was stepping down after the maximum eight years allowed by the constitution and had not named a successor.
evidence.title: Nigeria ruling party picks ex-governor of Lagos Tinubu to run for president
evidence.excerpt: Buhari was stepping down after the maximum eight years allowed by the constitution and had not named a successor.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Contemporaneous Reuters reporting syndicated by Euronews; independent on succession facts, though secondhand on publication path.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly about Buhari’s end-of-term political position.
contrary_evidence: Syndicated copy, so the underlying Reuters text is stronger than the host page presentation.

evidence.claim: Buhari signed bills intended to improve Nigeria’s anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing/proliferation financing framework.
evidence.title: President Buhari Signs Three Bills Into Law
evidence.excerpt: Buhari signed bills intended to improve Nigeria’s anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing/proliferation financing framework.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential release on a dated legislative assent with explicit proliferation-financing language.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Buhari assent, so this is ruler-attributed legal action.
contrary_evidence: This is institutional rather than nuclear-specific; it addresses financing controls, not weapons decisions.

evidence.claim: Buhari told Nigerians to remain vigilant, avoid panic, and noted that security measures had been reinforced after the July prison raid.
evidence.title: President Buhari to Security Agencies, All Persons: Be Alert, Don’t Panic
evidence.excerpt: Buhari told Nigerians to remain vigilant, avoid panic, and noted that security measures had been reinforced after the July prison raid.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential press release dated to the 2022 security context.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Directly attributable to Buhari’s public crisis messaging.
contrary_evidence: This is reassurance language, not proof that the threat was resolved.

evidence.claim: The NNRA Nuclear Security Division is responsible for ensuring Nigeria meets its national and international obligations on nuclear security and protecting nuclear and radioactive materials against unauthorized removal and sabotage.
evidence.title: Nuclear Safety and Security
evidence.excerpt: The NNRA Nuclear Security Division is responsible for ensuring Nigeria meets its national and international obligations on nuclear security and protecting nuclear and radioactive materials against unauthorized removal and sabotage.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official regulatory department page with direct functional description.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This is country-level safety infrastructure that Buhari governed, not a personal nuclear command record.
contrary_evidence: Institutional capability does not establish that the president personally directed safety practice.

evidence.claim: The NNRA lists the Nigeria Nuclear Research Reactor (NIRR-I) at Ahmadu Bello University as a 30 kW miniature neutron source reactor licensed by NNRA.
evidence.title: Nuclear Facilities
evidence.excerpt: The NNRA lists the Nigeria Nuclear Research Reactor (NIRR-I) at Ahmadu Bello University as a 30 kW miniature neutron source reactor licensed by NNRA.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Official facility page naming the reactor, location, and license status.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This supports limited nuclear exposure under Buhari’s state, not strategic nuclear command authority.
contrary_evidence: A research reactor is not evidence of a weapons program or command-and-control burden like a nuclear arsenal.

evidence.claim: An IAEA workshop report says Nigeria was embarking on a nuclear power programme and would need to improve additional-protocol declarations and safeguards infrastructure.
evidence.title: IAEA Hosts First Ever ‘Safeguards Implementation Practices Workshop’ for Practitioners
evidence.excerpt: An IAEA workshop report says Nigeria was embarking on a nuclear power programme and would need to improve additional-protocol declarations and safeguards infrastructure.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: IAEA reporting with a named Nigerian regulator quote; useful but dated and partly forward-looking.
evidence.ruler_attribution: This reflects the inherited nuclear-infrastructure pathway Buhari governed into 2022.
contrary_evidence: The report is from 2016 and describes future planning, not a 2022 operational decision.

evidence.claim: Buhari said Nigeria had converted the NIRR-1 research reactor from highly enriched uranium to low enriched uranium and had set up a Nuclear Security Support Centre and detection architecture.
evidence.title: Trafficking in Nuclear Materials Potential Threat to International Peace, Security- President Buhari
evidence.excerpt: Buhari said Nigeria had converted the NIRR-1 research reactor from highly enriched uranium to low enriched uranium and had set up a Nuclear Security Support Centre and detection architecture.
evidence.source_confidence_reason: Primary presidential statement with concrete nuclear-security measures and a dated release.
evidence.ruler_attribution: Direct Buhari claim about measures taken by his administration; useful inherited-baseline evidence for 2022 posture.
contrary_evidence: This is self-reported and predates 2022, though the underlying measures are concrete if independently verified elsewhere.
